root_idea.summary: The root centers on bending, inclining, or turning one side toward another.
root_idea.development: From physical flexure and the body's side, the usage develops into turning toward or away, favorable inclination and compassion, bodily or spatial bends, and related clothing and implement terms.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested group is displayed under the normalized noun citation form عِطْف.

senses.definition: The side of the body, extending from the head toward the hip; in the Quranic phrase ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ, the neck or side is bent or twisted.
senses.usage_conditions: A bodily noun. In 22:9 the phrase ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ is interpreted as bending or twisting the neck.

senses.definition: In ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ, to turn away haughtily, magnifying oneself and rejecting the truth.
senses.usage_conditions: This figurative interpretation belongs to the fixed Quranic construction and depicts proud turning away, specifically from Islam in the cited discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline or bend; to become inclined or bent, including an animal bending its neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive usage; the bending may be physical or directional.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline favorably toward someone; to show affection, kindness, mercy, pity, or compassion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With عَلَى; of a she-camel toward her young, it may include yielding her milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn or return against someone; to charge or attack.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A hostile directional construction, especially in battle or in returning against an opponent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn away or back; with عَنْ, to be averse, disaffected, or unkind toward someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning reverses the favorable inclination associated with عَطَفَ عَلَيْهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline, bend, double, or fold something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive physical usage, applied to objects such as a stick, wood, a camel's head, or a cushion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone or something to incline favorably toward another; to cause a she-camel to affect her young.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative transitive usage; the camel construction concerns inducing attachment so that milk is yielded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The turning or shuffling of a gaming arrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term associated with the gaming arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a garment over another's shoulders as an عِطَاف or cloak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II clothing usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make one's body bend or curve.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily movement comparable to swaying or bending the body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To clothe oneself with a cloak or wrap; figuratively, to be clothed or invested with might.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The literal construction takes بِـ with the garment; the figurative usage applies the clothing image to power.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline favorably toward one another; to show mutual affection, kindness, or compassion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reciprocal Form VI usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sway, move the head from side to side, or incline from side to side while walking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage may describe an elegant, proud, or self-conscious gait.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hang a bow or sword from oneself by placing its strap around the neck or shoulder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII usage with a weapon or bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ask someone to incline favorably toward one; to seek affection, goodwill, mercy, or reconciliation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X request or solicitation construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pliant, compliant, or easygoing in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use based on the body's side, as in the idiom أَلْيَنُ عِطْفًا; it can describe persons and, in related usage, a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The armpit or shoulder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical specialization distinct from the broader bodily-side sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The curved part at either extremity of a bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The two curved extremities are called its عِطْفَان.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bend or curved part of a street, road, or valley; by extension, a side or deviation from the beaten track.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used spatially of a route or road.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The length of the edges of the eyelids and an upward bending of them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare and disputed usage; the cited discussion reports that the form غَطَف may be the better-established reading.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An inclination or act of inclining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a verbal noun or noun of action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bead used by women to captivate men.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tree or twining plant to which a grapevine clings; it is also identified in one account with lablab.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical usage connected with bending or twining around trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hanging extremities or tendrils of a vine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Botanical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant identified as عُصْبَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plant name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A leafless twining desert plant, reportedly fed upon by wild cattle and harmful to them; its roots were also associated with a purported love charm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The account includes reported or folkloric claims about the plant's use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a twisted horn, said of a sheep or goat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet for an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloak, mantle, shoulder garment, or wrap worn like a ridāʾ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The garment is associated with falling against the two sides of the neck.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transferred designation based on the sword's being carried like a shoulder garment; it occurs in expressions about placing the sword at the side or beneath the armpit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gaming arrow that inclines toward or returns among the other arrows, is repeatedly drawn, or turns aside from their usual places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical terminology of the game of maysir; variant explanations describe its repeated return or solitary course among the arrows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Very inclined to favor, affectionate, kind, merciful, or compassionate; a benefactor or protector. It can also describe an affectionate woman or a she-camel attached to a substitute young.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive adjective; the camel usage concerns attachment to a stuffed skin after the loss of its young.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A snare, trap, or net containing a bent or inclined piece of wood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized implement name, also called غَاطُوف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gentle woman without pride, submissive or obedient in disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited usage is specifically an epithet for a woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is given as عَطَائِف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who returns to the fight after fleeing or wheeling away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited plural عَطَّافُونَ is an epithet for returning combatants.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gazelle bending its neck when lying down; also a sheep or goat bending its neck without illness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal epithet describing the posture of the neck.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The horse that arrives sixth, or according to another report fourth, in a race.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported ranking and attribution are variant and uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bias or cause of inclination.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative noun of agency: something that inclines a person toward another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A relationship or tie of kinship.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used substantivally for the relationship itself, synonymous with kinship or the womb-tie.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Affection, kindness, mercy, pity, or compassion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative emotional usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of bending or flexure; a bodily fold or crease, including a fold of a garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural may refer to bodily places where sweat collects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow whose curved extremity is bent strongly toward the other.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intensive pattern may describe one bow or multiple bent bows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milch camels made to incline toward a young one so that they yield milk copiously.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized passive-participial usage concerning several she-camels attached to one young.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Inclined or bent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a bow whose curved extremity is strongly bent toward the other.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place of inclining or bending, such as a bend in a valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place noun used of geographical features and routes.

cautions: The Quranic figurative sense is tied to the construction ثَانِيَ عِطْفِهِ; it should not be generalized as a standalone meaning for every use of عِطْف.
The eyelid-edge meaning is rare and reported with a competing attribution to غَطَف.
The race-position meaning of عَاطِف is reported variably as fourth or sixth and with questioned attribution.
